summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Investigation summary (read-only, no changes made)  I traced the full watchlist path end-to-end before proposing anything:  - **Client** (`client/src/pages/WatchlistPage.tsx`, `client/src/lib/api.ts`): loads via `GET /watchlist` on mount, saves via `POST/DELETE .../items`, always sends `credentials: "include"`. No localStorage/anonymous fallback exists anywhere in the client. - **Backend** (`modules/watchlist/handlers.ts`): every route is behind an auth middleware that resolves the session cookie → `X-User-Id`, and every query (`SELECT`/`INSERT`/`DELETE`) filters by `watchlists.user_id`.
